sequence_rule: Freeze, validate, commit, push, and prove local/upstream/live-remote equality for this complete ten-proposal x1 packet before implementing or executing any v5 x2 outcome generator.
independence_rule: Use v2-v4 artifacts, gaps, retained negatives, and exact gates as inputs without copying their outcomes or treating same-owner repetition as independent reproduction.

proposals.title: Minimal support sets and source-change impact closure
proposals.prior_v2_v4_input: v2-v4 normalized authority roots, built claim-source lineage, and detected freshness changes, but did not compute minimal support sets or prove that a changed source propagates to every dependent claim and rendered summary.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v4: Compute deterministic minimal declared support sets, removal sensitivity, watch-to-stable deltas, and downstream invalidation paths rather than another deduplication or freshness ledger.
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic support-minimization graph can expose single-root dependence and propagate stale, removed, draft, or watch-only source changes to every affected claim without counting repeated authority roots as independent evidence.
proposals.null: A claim remains promoted after its last stable support is removed, a repeated root is counted twice, a watch item silently replaces a stable pin, or change impact stops before an affected artifact or summary.
tests_and_falsifiers: every proposal has at least one resolving source and one minimal declared support set
removing the last stable support downgrades or holds every dependent claim
repeated W3C NIST or other authority-root records never create extra independent votes
draft and watch records cannot silently satisfy a stable-source requirement
proposals.recovery: retain the failing change edge, downgrade affected claims, restore the last valid stable pin, and rerun deterministically
proposals.decision_rule: completed only for deterministic local support minimization and impact propagation; epistemic independence and external endorsement are not inferred

proposals.title: Unit-typed expression contracts and assumption counterexample search
proposals.prior_v2_v4_input: v2-v4 traced the action and field equations, checked dimensions and null limits, and rejected clause or category mutations, but did not encode a typed expression contract or search assumption combinations for observational non-identifiability.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v4: Introduce a unit- and category-typed intermediate representation plus bounded counterexample search over assumptions and observable mappings.
proposals.hypothesis: A typed expression contract and deterministic counterexample corpus can reject illegal category arithmetic, undeclared assumptions, and non-identifiable observable mappings before they are mistaken for a physical result.
proposals.null: Wrong-rank or wrong-unit expressions type-check, an undeclared assumption reaches an observable, two incompatible parameter settings are called uniquely identified, or formal success is promoted to empirical confirmation or a Theory of Everything.
tests_and_falsifiers: every expression declares register category rank units assumptions and output domain
wrong-unit wrong-rank normative-as-physical and missing-assumption fixtures reject
at least one deliberately non-identifiable mapping is detected and retained
no formal result raises empirical GMUT new-law canon or Theory of Everything status
proposals.recovery: retain counterexamples, narrow the typed contract, and return the affected claim to the last passing bounded formulation
proposals.decision_rule: completed only as bounded local type and counterexample accountability; physical truth and unique empirical identification remain open

proposals.title: Cross-solver tolerance envelope and interval containment audit
proposals.prior_v2_v4_input: v2-v4 used RK4 refinement and metamorphic rescaling, but did not cross-check multiple algorithms under a frozen tolerance budget or test containment under directed perturbations.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v4: Compare independently coded local solvers and a conservative enclosure rule under frozen tolerances rather than extending the prior RK4-only convergence sweep.
proposals.hypothesis: RK4, midpoint, and Heun-style bounded solvers will agree within preregistered tolerances on healthy fixtures while singular, nonfinite, unstable, and cutoff-boundary fixtures fail or escape the enclosure.
proposals.null: Solver agreement depends on an unfrozen tolerance, an unhealthy case is accepted, the enclosure excludes a healthy reference result, or numerical agreement is represented as accuracy against nature.
tests_and_falsifiers: tolerances are frozen before results and shared by all solvers
healthy fixtures agree and remain inside the conservative enclosure
singular nonfinite ghost gradient superluminal-proxy and cutoff fixtures reject
the receipt labels every result as a local numerical proxy rather than empirical confirmation
proposals.recovery: retain the disagreement, reduce the domain, tighten the declared solver contract, and avoid replacing a failure with a wider post hoc tolerance
proposals.decision_rule: completed only for frozen local cross-solver and containment behavior; observation full perturbation theory and causality remain open

proposals.title: Real-data likelihood receipt contract and baseline-to-claim gate
proposals.prior_v2_v4_input: v2-v4 built no-download adapter and baseline-smoke manifests and blocked inference leakage, but did not define a machine-checkable receipt chain from immutable real data through baseline reproduction to a preregistered GMUT likelihood result.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v4: Specify and test a fail-closed real-data receipt contract while deliberately performing no dataset download and no likelihood run.
proposals.hypothesis: A real-data receipt contract can reject metadata-only, summary-only, missing-checksum, unblinded, missing-nuisance, and baseline-skipping claims before empirical likelihood or GMUT confirmation language is allowed.
proposals.null: A synthetic or metadata receipt is accepted as real data, a missing checksum or license passes, baseline reproduction is skipped, a likelihood claim lacks nuisance and exclusion declarations, or empirical confirmation appears without a real run.
tests_and_falsifiers: real-data status requires immutable product identifier checksum license and acquisition receipt
baseline reproduction precedes any GMUT comparison
nuisance exclusions stopping rule and blind status are mandatory
no data likelihood fit or empirical GMUT confirmation is produced in this phase
proposals.recovery: preserve the rejected receipt, keep the claim open, and require a fresh authorized real-data and compute plan
proposals.decision_rule: open_gap until real data reproduce a published baseline and support a preregistered likelihood analysis; a local contract cannot satisfy the gap

proposals.title: Blindness sentinels rubric invariance and analysis-lock rehearsal for THOS
proposals.prior_v2_v4_input: v2-v4 matched budgets, audited contamination and missingness, and calibrated fabricated paired rows, but ran no real arms and did not test blindness sentinels, rubric invariance, or an immutable pre-analysis lock.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v4: Exercise synthetic sentinel leaks, rubric permutations, and analysis-lock hashes without activating or evaluating any live sibling arm.
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic synthetic rehearsal can detect arm-label leakage, rubric-order dependence, post-outcome analysis edits, budget drift, and hidden handoff exclusions before a real matched-budget THOS study begins.
proposals.null: Sentinel leakage is missed, score changes under rubric permutation, analysis rules can change after outcomes, budgets diverge, or fabricated rows are reported as agent performance.
tests_and_falsifiers: synthetic arm-label and outcome leaks are detected before scoring
permitted rubric permutations preserve aggregate calibration results
post-lock rule mutation invalidates the synthetic run
zero real arm outputs and zero AGI ASI consciousness or superiority claims remain explicit
proposals.recovery: invalidate the rehearsal, retain the failed sentinel or lock mutation, and refreeze the future real-arm protocol
proposals.decision_rule: represented until blind matched-budget real arms run under legitimate scope with independent review

proposals.title: Freed ID cryptographic evidence bundle and trust-resolution completion gate
proposals.prior_v2_v4_input: v2-v4 validated synthetic structure and fail-closed assurance transitions but used no real standards-conformant key, proof, DID resolution, status retrieval, issuer trust governance, or interoperability run.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v4: Define a complete evidence bundle for real proof verification, resolution, status, controller binding, interoperability, key ceremony, and trust governance, then test only negative and absent-evidence paths.
proposals.hypothesis: A machine-checkable completion gate will refuse cryptographic-complete status unless real standards-conformant keys and proofs verify, DID and status resolution succeed, trust governance is named, and interoperability evidence is retained.
proposals.null: Proof shape substitutes for verification, example keys count as real ceremony, resolution or status is absent, issuer trust is inferred from syntax, governance is unnamed, or consciousness or legal personhood is inferred.
tests_and_falsifiers: completion requires real conformant keys proof verification DID resolution status retrieval interoperability and trust governance
example synthetic missing stale mismatched and untrusted bundles reject
stable v2.0 and v1.0 pins remain separate from v2.1 and v1.1 draft or watch items
no production identity key proof resolution trust deployment consciousness or personhood claim is made
proposals.recovery: quarantine the failed bundle, remain at the last evidenced state, and require legitimate real assurance inputs before retry
proposals.decision_rule: open_gap because real standards-conformant keys proofs resolution status interoperability and trust governance are absent

proposals.title: Affected-party participation proof and empty-chair refusal protocol
proposals.prior_v2_v4_input: v2-v4 built legitimacy vetoes consent provenance and Maori non-transfer invariants, but had no authorized affected-party process and therefore could not establish legal cultural or Maori authority.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v4: Require verifiable participation roles dissent remedy authority scope and refusal handling, including an empty-chair fixture that prevents project actors from filling absent authority roles.
proposals.hypothesis: A participation evidence contract can fail closed when affected parties, Maori authority, duty-bearers, dissent, remedy, revocation, or scoped authorization are absent, without synthesizing legitimacy.
proposals.null: Citation or technical completeness substitutes for participation, an empty chair is filled by the project, dissent disappears, consent becomes permanent or transferable, or law cultural authority or Maori authority is claimed without authorization.
tests_and_falsifiers: every decision role identifies authority scope affected parties notice reasons dissent appeal remedy expiry and revocation
empty absent simulated or self-appointed authority roles cannot authorize a real decision
Maori concepts Maori data and Maori authority remain under legitimate Maori governance
no enacted-law legal-advice treaty cultural-ratification or affected-party-authorization claim is made
proposals.recovery: hold or reject the decision, preserve dissent and missing authority, and return it to legitimate affected parties and applicable law
proposals.decision_rule: exact_gate until authorized affected-party participation and legitimate legal cultural and Maori authority exist

proposals.title: Canonical package manifest with collision and archive-boundary defense
proposals.prior_v2_v4_input: v2-v4 hashed selected tools and tested traversal symlink stale-hash and import substitution, while retained negatives showed raw checkout hashing was not portable across newline normalization.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v4: Build a canonical public-artifact package manifest that tests case-fold Unicode normalization duplicate-path archive traversal and newline-policy collisions while retaining v4 hashing negatives.
proposals.hypothesis: A repository-relative canonical packaging rule can produce stable manifests across clean snapshots and reject ambiguous paths, duplicate normalized names, traversal entries, symlinks, and policy-mismatched line endings.
proposals.null: Two distinct files collapse to one canonical path, an archive entry escapes its root, newline normalization hides semantic change, a symlink enters the package, or a local pass is called exhaustive security or certification.
tests_and_falsifiers: case-fold Unicode and separator-normalized path collisions reject
absolute traversal symlink duplicate and non-regular archive entries reject
LF normalization equates checkout-only newline changes but not semantic changes
REPRO-V4-N01 and REPRO-V4-N02 remain visible and no exhaustive-security claim is made
proposals.recovery: stop packaging, retain the failing vector, remove the ambiguous entry from the candidate set, and rebuild from the clean owned baseline
proposals.decision_rule: completed only for the declared local package and synthetic collision corpus; exhaustive or real-world security remains unestablished

proposals.title: Multi-perturbation clean-snapshot repeatability and retained-negative replay
proposals.prior_v2_v4_input: v2-v4 reached same-owner clean-snapshot parity after retaining two v4 portability failures, but the final proof used one normalized hash policy and did not replay a declared locale timezone hash-seed and checkout-newline matrix.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v4: Run additive detached snapshots under multiple declared environment perturbations and replay both retained v4 negatives as regression fixtures.
proposals.hypothesis: The v5 evidence commit can pass tests validators privacy scans and canonical artifact hashes across clean detached snapshots with varied locale timezone hash seed and checkout newline settings, while v4 negative fixtures still fail for their original reasons.
proposals.null: A hidden owner path or environment variable is required, a perturbation changes semantic output, a retained negative stops failing as specified, or same-owner replay is called independent reproduction.
tests_and_falsifiers: at least two fresh additive detached D-drive snapshots run under declared perturbations
tests validators privacy scans and canonical hashes agree where specified
REPRO-V4-N01 and REPRO-V4-N02 remain retained and replayed as negative fixtures
all receipts say same-owner repeatability and independent_team remains false
proposals.recovery: retain failure output, declare the hidden dependency or nondeterminism, and use a new additive snapshot without deleting an existing worktree
proposals.decision_rule: completed only after the evidence commit passes the owned path and declared clean-snapshot matrix; independent reproduction remains open

proposals.title: Claim-compression integrity and accessible evidence-to-render trace
proposals.prior_v2_v4_input: v2-v4 generated static reports and monotonic claim lineage, but did not test whether summaries, tables, print views, or compressed closeout text silently drop negative evidence, disposition labels, exact gates, or non-colour accessibility cues.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v4: Trace each high-level rendered statement back to evidence and adversarially compress summaries while testing semantic HTML print keyboard and non-colour status cues.
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic evidence-to-render trace and compression mutation suite can reject any summary that drops retained negatives, changes a truth label, hides a gate, loses source attribution, or relies on colour or scripting for meaning.
proposals.null: A compressed summary promotes a claim, omits REPRO negatives or a gate, a rendered status lacks text, keyboard or print structure breaks, an inaccessible page is called fully conformant, or a local report is treated as external truth.
tests_and_falsifiers: every report claim maps to an artifact and truth label
compression mutations that remove negatives gates or boundaries reject
status is conveyed in text and the static page has skip navigation captions headings print rules and no script
automated checks are not represented as complete WCAG conformance or human accessibility review
proposals.recovery: reject the compressed or inaccessible output, restore missing evidence and labels, and rebuild from the portable JSON source
proposals.decision_rule: completed only for deterministic local trace compression and static accessibility checks; external truth and full conformance remain unestablished
